obligations.description: - `chain-wizard-flexibility.md` still leaks orchestrator ownership into pre-run CUP/quality blocking, still omits hard lineage keys from the normalized downstream payload (`project_id`, thread/report identity), and still overstates Contribute(PR) as “no worktrees” rather than a stable-branch policy with isolated runtime execution underneath.
exact_items: - `chain-wizard-flexibility.md` still leaks orchestrator ownership into pre-run CUP/quality blocking, still omits hard lineage keys from the normalized downstream payload (`project_id`, thread/report identity), and still overstates Contribute(PR) as “no worktrees” rather than a stable-branch policy with isolated runtime execution underneath.
